tui.sound.added.role: TUI /sound command receipt or refusal (a notice line in the transcript)
tui.sound.added.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.added.note: {name} is the user's display name for the sound, {id} its machine id (verbatim, lowercase-hyphenated), {seconds} a decimal like 1.25. `/sound use {id}` is a command and stays verbatim.

tui.sound.added_selected.role: TUI /sound command receipt or refusal (a notice line in the transcript)
tui.sound.added_selected.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next

tui.sound.disabled.role: TUI /sound command receipt or refusal (a notice line in the transcript)
tui.sound.disabled.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.disabled.note: Receipt for `/sound off`. 'Banners' are desktop notification banners.

tui.sound.enabled.role: TUI /sound command receipt or refusal (a notice line in the transcript)
tui.sound.enabled.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next

tui.sound.id_help.note: One line under the Sound row of the TUI /settings page; it REPLACES the shared wire help there. The line is cut with an ellipsis at the detail width, so the TUI-only facts come FIRST: the row plays a sound as the cursor arrows onto it, then /sound add and /sound doctor. `system` is a setting value and stays verbatim; /sound add and /sound doctor are commands and stay verbatim.

tui.sound.list_hint.role: Hint line under the `/sound list` heading
tui.sound.list_hint.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.list_hint.note: Commands and <id> stay verbatim. Must fit one notice line at 60 columns (about 54 cells).

tui.sound.list_title.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.list_title.note: Bare heading; the command hints moved to tui.sound.list_hint so no heading wraps at 60 columns.

tui.sound.list_yours.role: Sub-heading before the user's own (custom) sounds in `/sound list`
tui.sound.list_yours.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.list_yours.note: Bare sub-heading; the commands are tui.sound.list_yours_hint.

tui.sound.list_yours_hint.role: Hint line under the user's own sounds in `/sound list`
tui.sound.list_yours_hint.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.list_yours_hint.note: Commands, <id> and <name> stay verbatim. Must fit one notice line at 60 columns (about 54 cells).

tui.sound.not_found.role: TUI /sound command receipt or refusal (a notice line in the transcript)
tui.sound.not_found.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.not_found.note: {id} is what the user typed (verbatim). /sound list stays verbatim.

tui.sound.off.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next

tui.sound.preview_muted.role: TUI /sound command receipt or refusal (a notice line in the transcript)
tui.sound.preview_muted.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.preview_muted.note: LOCAL_OPERATOR_NO_SOUND is an environment variable name and stays verbatim.

tui.sound.preview_playing.role: TUI /sound command receipt or refusal (a notice line in the transcript)
tui.sound.preview_playing.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.preview_playing.note: {name} is a sound's display name, {volume} a number 0–100.

tui.sound.preview_silent.role: TUI /sound command receipt or refusal (a notice line in the transcript)
tui.sound.preview_silent.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.preview_silent.note: Shown when the configured volume is 0.

tui.sound.preview_ssh.role: TUI /sound command receipt or refusal (a notice line in the transcript)
tui.sound.preview_ssh.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.preview_ssh.note: Refusal: lop runs on a remote machine over SSH; playing there would sound on that machine.

tui.sound.preview_system.role: TUI /sound command receipt or refusal (a notice line in the transcript)
tui.sound.preview_system.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.preview_system.note: `system` is a setting value and stays verbatim.

tui.sound.read_failed.role: TUI /sound command receipt or refusal (a notice line in the transcript)
tui.sound.read_failed.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.read_failed.note: {file} is the path the user typed, {reason} an operating-system error text (may be English).

tui.sound.removed.role: TUI /sound command receipt or refusal (a notice line in the transcript)
tui.sound.removed.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next

tui.sound.renamed.role: TUI /sound command receipt or refusal (a notice line in the transcript)
tui.sound.renamed.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.renamed.note: {id} machine id, {name} the new display name.

tui.sound.save_failed.role: TUI /sound command receipt or refusal (a notice line in the transcript)
tui.sound.save_failed.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.save_failed.note: {reason} is an English validation or OS error text from the settings writer.

tui.sound.section_description.role: Description of the Notification sound section in the TUI command palette
tui.sound.section_description.note: Replaces the shared wire section description in the TUI palette only, because the shared one names a shell command. 1.5 seconds is a literal number; /sound stays verbatim.

tui.sound.selected.role: TUI /sound command receipt or refusal (a notice line in the transcript)
tui.sound.selected.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.selected.note: Receipt for `/sound use <id>`. {name} is the sound's display name.

tui.sound.slash.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.slash.note: Description of the /sound command in the slash-command picker and /help. Keep it short: the description column wraps past about 55 cells.

tui.sound.status.role: TUI /sound command receipt or refusal (a notice line in the transcript)
tui.sound.status.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.status.note: Reply to a bare `/sound`. {name} display name, {volume} 0–100, {state} is tui.sound.on or tui.sound.off.

tui.sound.usage.role: TUI /sound command receipt or refusal (a notice line in the transcript)
tui.sound.usage.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.usage.note: Usage line for an unknown /sound word. Every /sound word, <id>, <file>, <name>, [id], [name] and the flag --select stay verbatim; 0-100 is a literal range written with an ASCII hyphen (what the user types).

tui.sound.volume_range.role: TUI /sound command receipt or refusal (a notice line in the transcript)
tui.sound.volume_range.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.volume_range.note: Refusal for `/sound volume` with a value outside 0–100 or not a whole number.

tui.sound.volume_set.role: TUI /sound command receipt or refusal (a notice line in the transcript)
tui.sound.volume_set.tone: plain, calm, says what happened or what to do next
tui.sound.volume_set.note: Receipt for `/sound volume N`. {volume} is the number.
